verdict.rationale: Letta clearly lets an agent pick up where it left off: `resumeSession` restores a specific conversation or the agent's default one, and dreaming background subagents review recent conversations and consolidate lessons into persistent memory. It does not document a developer-facing way to retrieve summaries of past sessions or threads, so only the continuity half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: an explicit session/thread summary feature or API that developers can retrieve, documentation of how context compaction summarizes history, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get summaries of past sessions or threads so an agent can pick up where the last conversation left off

citations.quote: pass an `agent-xxx` ID to resume the agent's default conversation, or a `conv-xxx` ID to resume a specific conversation.
Dreaming uses background subagents to review recent conversations, consolidate useful lessons, and update memory without interrupting your active work.
You can return to the same agent across sessions, computers, and interfaces instead of starting from scratch each time.
